images.caption: Figure 1:Layer by layer, module by module.Heatmaps showing the optimality frequency of each layer–module pair, i.e., how often it achieves the highest probing accuracy, with marginal distributions of optimal layers (top) and modules (right). For both vision foundation models (left) and large language models (OPENright)\textbf{right}), performance depends jointly on layer and module choices. The probing baseline on the final-layer residual stream (∘\circ) is largely suboptimal, while the fixed strategiesAct@100andLN2@60, for vision and language (⋆{\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\star}), respectively, often achieve the best performance.
